traducao: A secret arte that executes high-speed spinning slashes while juggling enemies in the air.

original: 獅子戦吼
闘気を敵に叩き付け吹き飛ばす秘技
traducao: A secret arte that slams fighting spirit into the enemy to blow them away.

original: 獅吼旋破
敵を回転斬りにより巻き込み闘気を叩き付ける奥義
traducao: An arcane arte that draws enemies into a spinning slash and slams them with fighting spirit.

original: 飛天翔駆
空中に飛び上がり、急降下によって敵を攻撃する奥義
traducao: An arcane arte that leaps into the air and attacks enemies with a rapid dive.

original: 魔神空牙衝
魔神剣と瞬迅剣を組合わせた奥義
traducao: An arcane arte that combines Demon Fang and Sonic Thrust.

original: 魔神双破斬
魔神剣と虎牙破斬を組合わせた奥義
traducao: An arcane arte that combines Demon Fang and Tiger Blade.

original: 烈風空牙衝
回転斬り後、突きを繰り出す奥義
traducao: An arcane arte that follows a spinning slash with a thrust.

original: 獅吼烈風
裂空斬と獅子戦吼を組合わせた奥義
traducao: An arcane arte that combines Tempest and Beast.

original: 驟雨双破斬
散沙雨と虎牙破斬を組合わせた奥義
traducao: An arcane arte that combines Sword Rain and Tiger Blade.

original: 獅子千裂破
連続突きの後、止めに獅子戦吼を放つ奥義
traducao: An arcane arte that unleashes rapid thrusts and finishes with Beast.

original: 真空千裂破
散沙雨と裂空斬を組合わせた奥義
traducao: An arcane arte that combines Sword Rain and Tempest.

original: 天翔蒼破斬
飛燕連脚
連続して回転蹴りを行う特技
traducao: A skill that executes consecutive spinning kicks.

original: 緋炎連脚
炎をまとった回転蹴りを連続して行う秘技
traducao: A secret arte that executes consecutive flame-cloaked spinning kicks.

original: 烈空斬
断空剣
回転斬りによって竜巻を生じさせつつ斬り上げる秘技
traducao: A secret arte that slashes upward while generating a tornado with a spinning slash.

original: 爪竜連牙斬
敵に踏み込みながら連撃を繰り出す奥義
traducao: An arcane arte that unleashes a flurry of attacks while stepping into the enemy.

original: 閃空裂破
剣圧で敵を浮かせ、その後止めの一撃を繰り出す秘技
traducao: A secret arte that lifts enemies with sword pressure and delivers a finishing blow.

original: 紅蓮剣
炎を纏った闘気を敵にぶつけて攻撃する奥義
traducao: An arcane arte that attacks enemies by slamming them with flame-cloaked fighting spirit.

original: 鳳凰天駆
炎の闘気を纏い鳳凰の如く、急降下攻撃をする奥義
traducao: An arcane arte that cloaks oneself in flame fighting spirit and dives like a phoenix.

original: 空牙昇竜脚
